about: Corby Spirit and Wine Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, markets, and imports spirits, wines, whiskies, vodkas, rums, liquors, gins, tequilas, bourbons, champagnes, and ready-to-drink cocktails in Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and internationally. It operates in two segments, Case Goods and Commissions. The company offers its products under the J.P. Wiser's, Lamb's, Polar Ice, McGuinness, Cottage Springs, Nude, Ungava, Chic Choc, Cabot Trail, The Foreign Affair Winery, Absolut, Chivas Regal, The Glenlivet, Ballantine's, Jameson, Beefeater, Malibu, Bumbu, Olmeca, Altos, Jefferson's, Rabbit Hole, Kahlúa, Mumm, Mott's, Clamato, Snapple, Tahiti Treat, Hires, Lot No. 40, Pike Creek, Gooderham & Worts, Royal Reserve, Skrewball, Codigo 1530, Martell, Havana Club, Ricard, Lillet, Brancott Estate, G.H. Mumm, Kenwood Vineyards, Perrier-Jouët, Aberlour, Royal Salute, Pernod, Soho, Redbreast, Spot Whiskeys, Ramazzotti, Midleton, Meaghers, Kayak, Quartz, Malfy Gin, Slow Press, Stave & Steel, Mumm Napa, and Wyndham Estate brands. It also provides logistics and bulk whisky services. The company was formerly known as Corby Distilleries Limited and changed its name to Corby Spirit and Wine Limited in November 2013. The company was founded in 1859 and is based in Toronto, Canada. Corby Spirit and Wine Limited operates as a subsidiary of Hiram Walker & Sons Limited.
